subject_line: Application for Python Developer — Ayushkumar Burde
body:
I am a Python Backend Developer with hands-on experience using FastAPI and Docker. I am applying for this role because it requires containerized microservices and REST API development.

I built an AI-powered resume platform using FastAPI and a RAG pipeline for content generation, covering the inference pipelines requirement. I also implemented a client inventory management system with REST API endpoints and Prisma ORM, which demonstrates my ability to build scalable backend services.

I bring production-ready deployment experience on AWS EC2 to your team. Let’s discuss how I can contribute to your backend architecture.
